propositions: AC checklist items with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, store-surgery) but lacking [operator-attested] tag are not flagged at plan time, causing verification failures that require retroactive tag addition
A deterministic advisory lexicon lint for p6_ac_quality detects untagged operational-evidence AC items using a frozen corpus and achieves ≥70% precision and ≤5% flag rate
The [operator-attested] tag matcher must be single-sourced between the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier enrichment to guarantee agreement on what constitutes a tagged item
Both historical failures (tickets 115b and 8c4f) fire on their tag-stripped AC text when the lexicon lint runs, validating the detector on known cases
The lint is activated advisory and non-blocking in p6_ac_quality without adding new DET check P10 entries or modifying CANONICAL_DET / criteria_routing.json
The implementation is extracted to det_operator_attested.py module to comply with module-size ceiling constraints while maintaining single-source tag matcher identity
